pages.text: Tuff can now be polished, bricked and chiselled, with slabs, stairs and walls of each. Cut it in a $(item)Stonecutter$().

Copper grates, doors, trapdoors, bulbs, chests, lanterns, chains, bars and lightning rods. They all rust over time: wax them with $(item)Honeycomb$() to stop it, or scrape them back with an axe.$(br2)A $(item)Copper Bulb$() toggles its light each time it gets a redstone pulse.

Hit a $(l:gallifrey:backported/biomes)Creaking$() and resin grows on nearby pale oak. Smelt the clumps into resin bricks, then craft those into $(item)Resin Bricks$() for a warm orange building block.
